settings/sleepOnExit.title: Sleep on exit
settings/sleepOnExit.body: Put the PlayStation console into rest mode when you leave a Remote Play session.

settings/connectedControllers.title: Connected controllers
settings/connectedControllers.body: Open per-controller output, lightbar, haptics, and rumble settings. Wake a controller first so Akira can detect it.

settings/buttonMapping.title: Button mapping
settings/buttonMapping.body: Open the button-remapping screen for Remote Play controls.

settings/touchpad.title: Touchpad
settings/touchpad.body: Use the Switch touch screen as the DualSense touchpad during a stream.

settings/swipeGestures.title: Swipe gestures
settings/swipeGestures.body: Turn each touch-screen swipe direction on or off. A swipe sends the matching touchpad gesture to the console.

settings/rumbleSource.title: Rumble source
settings/rumbleSource.body: Off disables vibration. Haptic track derives rumble from the console's haptic signal. Game rumble plays the rumble the game asked for.

settings/hapticIntensity.title: Haptic intensity
settings/hapticIntensity.body: Scale how strongly haptics play on the Switch controllers.
